name: Sir Rupert Ashcombe

intro.text: Ah, the young walker. Tintagel, splendid, isn't it? We're thinking a gift shop in the castle. Perhaps a zip line to Merlin's cave.
Regional Director, England. Pryce spoke of you. Briefly, and with a twitch.

win: Good heavens. I shall have to write a strongly worded memo. To myself.
after: The mine near Penzance holds something rather valuable. Do keep away, there's a good sort.
